title: OOP deep: traits, static, late binding, immutability

preview.what: How PHP objects really behave: traits, static, late static binding, immutability.
preview.picture: A trait is a plug-in skill you copy into several classes; static is the noticeboard shared by all instances; an immutable object is a printed receipt — you issue a new one instead of editing it.
preview.why: Senior screens probe why static state breaks tests and when traits become a smell.
preview.bn: Trait = copy করা দক্ষতা, static = সবার শেয়ার করা বোর্ড, immutable = ছাপানো রিসিট, edit না, নতুন দাও।
